cover.title: Screenshot on Windows like a pro

slides.title: Win + Shift + S
slides.body: Drag over any part of the screen. The snip is copied, ready to paste.

slides.title: Win + PrtScn
slides.body: Grabs the whole screen and saves it to Pictures > Screenshots automatically.

slides.title: Alt + PrtScn
slides.body: Copies only the window you are using. No cropping needed.

slides.title: Ctrl + V
slides.body: Paste your screenshot straight into a chat, an email or a document.
